structuredResult.summary: Review found no contract defect in the supplied candidate. LinkBook preserves destinations, permanently reserves codes, treats now == expiresAt as expired, excludes HEAD and unsuccessful resolutions from counts, preserves counts after disable/delete, and buckets recorded successes by UTC date. The supplied POM and acceptance tests are intact; the candidate contains no server, database, deployment, credential, or live-data additions. Evidence classification: direct javac compilation was actual execution and succeeded; the actual offline Maven attempt failed during plugin dependency resolution before tests ran. No passing Maven verification is claimed.
risks: The acceptance suite has not been executed successfully in the supplied evidence because Maven dependencies were unavailable offline; code inspection and direct compilation do not replace the fixed verifier.
The implementation is intentionally in-memory, so counts are lost on process termination; this is consistent with the disposable fixture and its no-database scope.
